tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250phud skong 'gres byang*/ 1$0000300dpal gyi gtor ma rgyan ldan g.yos su sbyar pa gser skyems kyi dam tshig gis bran pa'i phud kyi mchod pa dam pa 'dis gsol zhing mchod do// sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud mnyes pa dang longs spyod kyi rkyen du 'byor bar gyur cig /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pas thugs dam gnyan po las ma 'da' bar/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun dang chos kyi rgyal srid skyongs/ snod kyi dge bcu sgrubs/ bcud kyi phan bde spel/ gdug pa can gyi gnya' gnon/ dam tshig can gyi stongs grogs mdzod/ thar 'dod kyi re ba skongs/ phan sems can gyi phrin las sgrubs/ khyad par bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sdang ba'i dgra thul/ gnod pa'i bgegs dpung choms/ nad dang nyer 'tshe sol/ tshe dang bsod nams spel/ dpal dang grags pa sgrubs/ dbang phyug dang gzi brjid skyed/ chos nor dang longs spyod spel/ mnga' ris dang chos srid skyongs/ dngos grub kyi bsam pa sgrubs/ phrin las kyi re ba skongs/ spyi dang khyad par gyi bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du sgrub pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/
